title: New Ransomware Variant "LockBit 4.0" Targets Enterprise Networks
excerpt: Security researchers have identified a new variant of LockBit ransomware with improved encryption speed and anti-analysis techniques. Organizations urged to patch VPN vulnerabilities immediately.
advice: Ensure all VPN and remote access solutions are patched. Implement network segmentation and maintain offline backups.

title: Massive Phishing Campaign Impersonates Indian Income Tax Department
excerpt: Attackers sending emails claiming tax refunds with malicious PDF attachments containing info-stealer malware. Over 50,000 emails detected in past week.
advice: Verify sender email addresses. Income Tax Dept never sends refund notifications with attachments. Report to reportphishing@cert-in.org.in

title: Critical Vulnerability in Popular File Sharing Library (CVE-2025-XXXX)
excerpt: A zero-day vulnerability in a widely-used open-source file upload library allows remote code execution. Patches available for all major versions.
advice: Update affected libraries immediately. Apply WAF rules if patching delayed. Monitor for unusual file upload activity.

title: QR Code Phishing (Quishing) Surges at Public Charging Stations
excerpt: Attackers placing malicious QR codes on EV charging stations and parking meters. Scanning leads to fake payment pages harvesting credentials.
advice: Verify QR code authenticity before scanning. Use official apps for payments. Check URL carefully after scanning.

title: New Android Banking Trojan "Hook" Targets 300+ Banking Apps
excerpt: Sophisticated malware with real-time screen streaming, keylogging, and automatic transaction capabilities. Distributed via fake app stores.
advice: Only install apps from Google Play Store. Enable Play Protect. Review app permissions. Use banking apps' built-in security features.

title: Data Breach at Major Indian EdTech Platform Exposes 2M Student Records
excerpt: Unsecured database exposed names, emails, phone numbers, and course progress. Company secured database after responsible disclosure.
advice: Monitor for phishing using exposed data. Enable MFA on all accounts. Consider credit monitoring if financial data exposed.

title: CISA Adds 3 Vulnerabilities to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
excerpt: Federal agencies ordered to patch within 2 weeks. Vulnerabilities affect Microsoft Exchange, Apache Struts, and Citrix ADC.
advice: Prioritize patching these KEV-listed vulnerabilities. Apply emergency patches if available. Scan networks for indicators of compromise.

title: Deepfake Audio Used in ₹2 Crore CEO Fraud at Mumbai Company
excerpt: Attackers used AI-generated voice clone of CEO to authorize fraudulent wire transfer. Finance team verified via email which was also compromised.
advice: Implement multi-channel verification for financial transactions. Establish secret passphrases for executive requests. Train finance teams on deepfake risks.

title: New IoT Botnet "Condi" Exploits TP-Link Router Vulnerability
excerpt: Botnet recruits routers for DDoS attacks. Vulnerability allows unauthenticated command execution. Over 10,000 devices infected in first week.
advice: Update router firmware immediately. Disable remote management. Change default credentials. Monitor network traffic for anomalies.

title: RBI Issues New Guidelines for Digital Payment Security
excerpt: Mandates tokenization for card-on-file, enhanced fraud monitoring, and customer liability protection. Deadline: December 2025.
advice: Businesses: implement tokenization. Consumers: use tokenized cards, enable transaction alerts, report unauthorized transactions within 3 days.

title: Supply Chain Attack: Malicious NPM Package Steals Crypto Wallets
excerpt: Popular npm package compromised in typosquatting attack. Malicious code exfiltrates private keys and seed phrases to attacker servers.
advice: Audit npm dependencies. Use lockfiles. Enable 2FA on npm accounts. Monitor for suspicious package updates.

title: WhatsApp "Pink" Scam Returns with New Social Engineering Tactics
excerpt: Messages offering "WhatsApp Pink" with exclusive features lead to malware installation. Over 1M users targeted in India.
advice: Never install apps from links in messages. WhatsApp updates only through official app stores. Report to cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Zero-Day in MOVEit Transfer Exploited by Cl0p Ransomware Gang
excerpt: Mass exploitation of file transfer vulnerability affects hundreds of organizations globally. Data theft confirmed at multiple Fortune 500 companies.
advice: Apply Progress Software patches immediately. Review all file transfer logs. Notify affected parties per regulatory requirements.

title: New SIM Swap Protection Rules Mandated by TRAI for Indian Telcos
excerpt: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India mandates stricter verification for SIM replacement requests. 24-hour cooling period for number porting.
advice: Set up SIM lock PIN with your carrier. Monitor for unexpected "SIM swap" SMS. Use authenticator apps instead of SMS 2FA where possible.

title: AI-Powered Phishing Emails Now Indistinguishable from Legitimate
excerpt: Researchers demonstrate GPT-generated phishing emails with perfect grammar, context awareness, and personalized details from OSINT. Detection rates drop to 3%.
advice: Verify unexpected requests through secondary channels. Implement DMARC/SPF/DKIM. Train employees on AI-generated threats. Use phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2).
